brains.name: Trade Integrity
brains.purpose: Checks trade data before anything is allowed to teach the AI.
brains.finding: No completed trade evidence has reached the validator yet.

brains.name: Winner School
brains.purpose: Studies profitable trades to discover repeatable characteristics worth finding again.
brains.finding: 0 winner fingerprints currently have repeated examples.

brains.name: Failure School
brains.purpose: Studies losses and poorly managed winners to identify behaviours worth avoiding.
brains.finding: 0 different failure categories are being tracked.

brains.name: Profit Capture
brains.purpose: Measures how much of a favourable move the system actually banked.

brains.name: Pattern Miner
brains.purpose: Looks for repeated Trade DNA patterns; patterns need enough examples before becoming evidence.
brains.finding: 0 patterns currently have enough evidence to be considered candidates.

brains.name: Management Challengers
brains.purpose: Replays alternative exit/profit-protection methods without changing live paper strategy.

brains.name: Committee Memory
brains.purpose: Tracks which specialist opinions are becoming useful over repeated validated trades.

brains.name: Market School
brains.purpose: Studies market behaviour and missed moves, not only trades the platform happened to take.
brains.finding: Studies both traded and missed market moves so trade history is not the only teacher.

brains.name: Microstructure
brains.purpose: Studies 1-minute and 5-minute timing, pullbacks, local exhaustion and reversals.
brains.finding: Separates entry, profit-protection, pullback and reversal timing rather than treating every turn as a new trade.

brains.name: AI Scorecard
brains.purpose: Summarises evidence maturity and decision-process quality; it is not a profitability promise.
brains.finding: This grades evidence/process maturity, not whether the next trade will win.

network.flow: Market observation → specialist agents → committee → trade → integrity gate → replay → Winner/Failure School → pattern/management challengers → committee memory → shared feedback
network.principle: Small samples stay labelled EARLY/LEARNING. No challenger or lesson automatically replaces the current strategy.
